_comment: Ship classes. Speeds in Mm per hour (600 Mm/h is about 167 km/s), acceleration in Mm per hour per hour (25 is about 0.2 g). Supplies are the one stock of fuel and ammo; each 1 Mm/h of speed gained or lost burns suppliesPerDeltaV. Full tank speed change = supplies / suppliesPerDeltaV.

classes.name: Gun frigate
classes.role: Fast and cheap, short legs. Railgun and point defence.

classes.name: Missile destroyer
classes.role: Long range, slower. Missile racks and point defence.
